basis: user reports UTM with direct USB forwarding; native x86 upload succeeds, both ARM64 and emulated x86 uploads fail under Windows ARM
hypothesis: Oversized interrupt OUT writes are acknowledged by QEMU before usbredirhost rejects them

sources.fact: Source comment states interrupt OUT success is reported immediately rather than awaiting host completion.
Rejects data_len greater than endpoint.max_packetsize with usb_redir_inval.

change: Bound each interrupt OUT WinUSB write to descriptor MaxPacket; bulk path unchanged; no timing sleeps or new Kinseal commands.

validation.regression: Modeled published host rejection with immediate guest success; 257-byte write fails delivery before fix, all sizes through 212104 pass afterward. This is a host-side model, not a real UTM capture.
validation.hardware_UTM: User confirmed version 0.2.5 successfully uploaded and display adopted the new project under UTM / Windows ARM.

hardware_result.environment: UTM on Apple Silicon, Windows ARM, direct USB forwarding
hardware_result.conclusion: Packet-sized interrupt OUT writes resolved the reported upload failure; exact installed usbredir/QEMU versions remain unverified.
